snippet.title: Combat Search Rescue - VR Game for Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Available on the Meta Horizon Store from 31st October 2025.

Combat Search Rescue is the first game in our VR 'n' Chill series, designed for Meta Quest VR gamers who don't have the time, space or energy to flail around their living room dodging missiles.

It's a retro-inspired, side-scrolling, space shoot 'em up that immerses you in the action, like being inside an arcade game of the 1980s, with enemies zipping past and lasers streaking by your head, but the gameplay remains third person side-scrolling.

Fly your spaceship with thumbsticks and buttons and stay planted comfortably in your favourite chair. That's the spirit of VR 'n' Chill.

Combat Search Rescue will be available on the Meta Horizon Store on 31st October 2025.
